\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R129-first-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a thick bangle and a bangle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a winnowing basket, a sieve, a grinding mill, a pestle, a rolling pin
  \item a rolling board, a wide platter, a bowl, tongs, a lock
  \item a box, a trunk, a chest, a quilt, a mattress
  \item a pillow, a sheet, a cotton rug, a curtain, a mirror
  \item a comb, soap, a towel, a needle, thread
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A winnowing basket? (\textbf{\mw{सूपड़ो}}, \emph{sūpṛo}.) A sieve? (\textbf{\mw{चाळणी}}, \emph{chāḷṇī}.) A grinding mill? (\textbf{\mw{चक्की}}, \emph{chakkī}.) A pestle? (\textbf{\mw{मूसळ}}, \emph{mūsaḷ}.) A rolling pin? (\textbf{\mw{बेलण}}, \emph{belaṇ}.) A rolling board? (\textbf{\mw{चकलो}}, \emph{chaklo}.) A wide platter? (\textbf{\mw{परात}}, \emph{parāt}.) A bowl? (\textbf{\mw{कटोरो}}, \emph{kaṭoro}.) Tongs? (\textbf{\mw{चिमटो}}, \emph{chimṭo}.) A lock? (\textbf{\mw{ताळो}}, \emph{tāḷo}.) A box? (\textbf{\mw{डब्बो}}, \emph{ḍabbo}.) A trunk? (\textbf{\mw{पेटी}}, \emph{peṭī}.) A chest? (\textbf{\mw{संदूक}}, \emph{sandūk}.) A quilt? (\textbf{\mw{रजाई}}, \emph{rajāī}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\mw{गादी}}, \emph{gādī}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\mw{तकियो}}, \emph{takiyo}.) A sheet? (\textbf{\mw{चादर}}, \emph{chādar}.) A cotton rug? (\textbf{\mw{दरी}}, \emph{darī}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\mw{पड़दो}}, \emph{paṛdo}.) A mirror? (\textbf{\mw{आरसी}}, \emph{ārsī}.) A comb? (\textbf{\mw{कांगसी}}, \emph{kā̃gsī}.) Soap? (\textbf{\mw{साबण}}, \emph{sābaṇ}.) A towel? (\textbf{\mw{तौलियो}}, \emph{tauliyo}.) A needle? (\textbf{\mw{सुई}}, \emph{suī}.) Thread? (\textbf{\mw{डोरो}}, \emph{ḍoro}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Tools and clothes — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R129-second-pass-tools-and-clothes}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for scissors and a lantern.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item scissors, a lantern, a candle, matches, wood
  \item coal, a dung cake, a sack, a rope, a peg
  \item a nail, a hammer, an axe, a plough, a bullock cart
  \item a turban, a long skirt, a woman's wrap, a bodice, a long coat
  \item a shirt, sandals, embroidered shoes, a thick bangle, a bangle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Scissors? (\textbf{\mw{कैंची}}, \emph{kaiñchī}.) A lantern? (\textbf{\mw{लालटेण}}, \emph{lālṭeṇ}.) A candle? (\textbf{\mw{मोमबत्ती}}, \emph{mombattī}.) Matches? (\textbf{\mw{माचिस}}, \emph{māchis}.) Wood? (\textbf{\mw{लकड़ी}}, \emph{lakṛī}.) Coal? (\textbf{\mw{कोयलो}}, \emph{koylo}.) A dung cake? (\textbf{\mw{छाणो}}, \emph{chhāṇo}.) A sack? (\textbf{\mw{बोरो}}, \emph{boro}.) A rope? (\textbf{\mw{रस्सी}}, \emph{rassī}.) A peg? (\textbf{\mw{खूंटी}}, \emph{khū̃ṭī}.) A nail? (\textbf{\mw{खीलो}}, \emph{khīlo}.) A hammer? (\textbf{\mw{हथोड़ो}}, \emph{hathoṛo}.) An axe? (\textbf{\mw{कुल्हाड़ी}}, \emph{kulhāṛī}.) A plough? (\textbf{\mw{हळ}}, \emph{haḷ}.) A bullock cart? (\textbf{\mw{बैलगाड़ी}}, \emph{bailgāṛī}.) A turban? (\textbf{\mw{पगड़ी}}, \emph{pagṛī}.) A long skirt? (\textbf{\mw{घाघरो}}, \emph{ghāghro}.) A woman's wrap? (\textbf{\mw{लूगड़ो}}, \emph{lūgṛo}.) A bodice? (\textbf{\mw{कांचळी}}, \emph{kā̃chaḷī}.) A long coat? (\textbf{\mw{अंगरखी}}, \emph{aṅgarkhī}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\mw{कमीज}}, \emph{kamīj}.) Sandals? (\textbf{\mw{चप्पल}}, \emph{chappal}.) Embroidered shoes? (\textbf{\mw{मोचड़ी}}, \emph{mochṛī}.) A thick bangle? (\textbf{\mw{कड़ो}}, \emph{kaṛo}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\mw{चूड़ी}}, \emph{chūṛī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
